newsitem.title: USA: Lawyers file suit against Foxmeyer Health.
newsitem.headline: Lawyers file suit against Foxmeyer Health.

text.p: A class action lawsuit was filed against Foxmeyer Health Corp on behalf of purchasers of the company's preferred shares, lawyers for the plaintiffs said.

The complaint alleges that company omitted or misrepresented material information about the company's operations and business prospects, the law firms said. Berger & Montague PC, Silber & Pearlman PC and Myron Harris filed the suit in the Northern District of Texas.
Foxmeyer Health's Foxmeyer Drug unit filed chapter 11 on August 27, 1996. The suit is on behalf of preferred stock buyers from July 19, 1995 through August 27, 1996, the firms said.
Foxmeyer Health representatives were not immediately available for comment.
